intro: The Tablet of Verga is an arcane stone inscribed with demonic runes essential for binding dark entities. Stolen by the sinister Burning Blade cult, it was taken deep into their lair within Skull Rock. Recovering the artifact allows dark practitioners in Orgrimmar to decipher the rituals needed to bind a voidwalker.

p: The Tablet of Verga holds specific ritual runes required to summon and bend creatures of the Nether to a master's will. When the Burning Blade cult managed to steal the tablet, they concealed it within a hidden chest inside Skull Rock, just east of Orgrimmar. For the warlocks working discreetly in the shadows of the Cleft of Shadow, regaining the relic is crucial—not only to study its ancient markings for summoning a voidwalker, but also to deny the fanatical cultists their own dark advantage.
